title: The Grass Compat: Vibrant Fibers
description: Lets you cut grass from Vibrant Journeys to get plant fiber from No Tree Punching!
body:
![Main Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f56ca8fe3f607b26c77248656e173e6978cf2f4a.png)

A simple datapack that lets you use the knives from No Tree Punching to collect plant fiber from the short grass and beach grass from Project Vibrant Journeys!

-Installation-

It's recommended that you use something like Paxi to load this datapack into every world. Since this isn't a mod, it takes a little bit of a different approach to set up.

Credits to AlcatrazEscapee and OrderedChaosDev for No Tree Punching and Project: Vibrant Journeys respectively!

-Issues-

Have any issues? Report them on the [github](https://github.com/KJFoxMC/NTP-VJ-Compat) page!
